news.title: Democrats hold 3-point lead on generic ballot: AARP poll
news.summary: Democrats lead by 3 points on a generic ballot against Republicans with the midterms less than three weeks out, according to a new poll. The AARP poll, released Thursday, found 49 percent of respondents backed Democrats and 46 percent backed Republicans, while 5 percent were unsure about their choice of party. The slight lead for…
